title: OrderSummary fails to render totals when PRICING_V2 is off, blocking checkout completion
digest: Checkout is unusable for ~40% of traffic. POST /api/v2/orders returns 200 OK but omits `data.total` when the backend PRICING_V2 flag is off, while the front-end OrderSummary component dereferences it unconditionally (EV-03). Neither side is individually wrong: the front-end was shipped against a contract the backend only honours with the flag on. Suspected layer is contract, high confidence — the fix is either a backend flag-independent `total` or a front-end guard, and the owning teams should pick.

preconditions: Signed in as a standard customer with a non-empty cart
Backend feature flag PRICING_V2 is OFF for the tenant
At least one line item with a promotional discount applied
steps: Navigate to https://staging.example.com/checkout with a cart containing a discounted item
Enter valid shipping details and continue to the payment step
Observe the order summary panel renders blank and the confirmation never appears

expected: POST /api/v2/orders returns a body containing data.total as a number, and OrderSummary renders the order total followed by the confirmation screen. The total field is documented as required in openapi/orders.yaml#/components/schemas/OrderResponse.
actual: The response is 200 OK but data.total is absent entirely. OrderSummary throws "TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')" at OrderSummary.tsx:42, the summary panel renders blank, and the confirmation screen never mounts. No error is shown to the user.

components.source_basis: stack frame in EV-03 plus declaration of OrderSummary

evidence.summary: User clicks [data-testid="place-order"]; the button transitions to disabled and shows its spinner
POST /api/v2/orders -> 200 OK in 41ms, response body has no `total` key under `data`
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed') at OrderSummary.tsx:42
evidence.detail:
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')
    at OrderSummary (src/checkout/OrderSummary.tsx:42:31)
    at renderWithHooks (react-dom.development.js:15486:18)
    at CheckoutPage (src/checkout/CheckoutPage.tsx:88:14)

evidence.summary: order-svc serialised the response through the legacy pricing path because PRICING_V2 resolved false for this tenant; that path never populates `total`
PRICING_V2 is enabled for 3 of 5 staging tenants, matching the intermittent reports across environments

diffs.consumer_impact: OrderSummary.tsx:42 calls total.toFixed(2) unconditionally, throwing a TypeError that unmounts the summary panel and halts checkout
Not yet dereferenced by the front-end, so latent — but it will break the same way once the tax line ships

fault_localization.rationale: The backend returned 200 with a body it considers complete (EV-04 shows LegacyOrderSerializer deliberately emitting four fields), and the front-end parsed a body it considers malformed (EV-03). Both behave as written, so neither is individually at fault — the shared contract is. EV-02 and EV-04 share correlation id 00-4bf92f35..., confirming this is one request and not two unrelated failures, and EV-05 explains why it reproduces on some tenants and not others.

alternatives.why_less_likely: OrderSummary is correct against the documented OpenAPI schema, which marks total as required. A defensive guard would mask the failure rather than fix the divergence — worth adding, but not the root cause.
order-svc is behaving exactly as its flag configuration specifies, with no error or exception on its side.
The response arrived intact in 41ms with a 200 status and well-formed JSON; nothing was truncated or dropped in transit.

open_questions: Was PRICING_V2 intended to be a permanent branch or a migration flag due for removal? That decides whether the fix belongs in the serializer or the flag config.
Does the production tenant set have PRICING_V2 off anywhere? If so this is a live outage, not a staging-only defect.

impact.description: Customers on tenants with PRICING_V2 off cannot complete checkout. The order summary renders blank and the confirmation screen never appears, so the user has no indication whether their order was placed — some will retry and risk duplicate orders.
impact.users_affected: All checkout users on the 2 of 5 staging tenants with PRICING_V2 off (~40% of staging traffic)
impact.business_impact: Complete checkout blockage on affected tenants; duplicate-order risk from user retries
impact.workaround: Enabling PRICING_V2 for the tenant restores the flow, but that is a config change with pricing consequences and is not a safe blanket remedy

triage.assignee_basis: No git history available for src/checkout/OrderSummary.tsx in this fixture
